projects.name: Kenya Financial Analytics
projects.description: A research terminal for Kenya’s financial markets, built around official CBK observations. It brings foreign exchange, Treasury-bill auctions, yield curves, bond and options pricing, portfolio analysis and risk tools into one place.
projects.preview_label: Kenya Financial Analytics · Kenyan market research terminal
projects.preview_alt: Kenya Financial Analytics research terminal showing the Kenyan market workspaces and source-aware market data
projects.project_story: Market observations, auction results and research tools often sit in separate places. I wanted one workspace where the numbers could be explored together without losing sight of where they came from.
projects.project_scope: FX and Treasury markets · Yield curves · Valuation · Portfolio and risk research

projects.name: StandPoint — Financial Intelligence
projects.description: A Kenyan financial intelligence platform combining market monitoring, quantitative finance tools, research, financial learning and a campus experience.
projects.preview_alt: StandPoint Yield Curve workspace interface preview based on the latest screen supplied on 11 November 2026
projects.preview_label: StandPoint · financial intelligence and yield-curve workspace
projects.project_story: I wanted financial information and useful campus tools to sit within one product, rather than asking students to move between unrelated services.
projects.project_scope: Market monitoring · Financial learning · Quantitative tools · Campus experience

projects.name: GDP Research Dashboard
projects.description: A macroeconomic research dashboard that keeps reported World Bank GDP data separate from IMF estimates and projections, with country comparisons, growth analysis and an indicator explorer.
projects.preview_label: GDP Research Dashboard · global macroeconomic research and data explorer
projects.preview_alt: GDP Research Dashboard overview showing the emerald global GDP chart, largest economies and source freshness information

projects.name: Kenya Yield Curve & Interest Rate Risk Engine
projects.description: A fixed-income research terminal for Treasury-bill observations, yield-curve construction, bond valuation and interest-rate risk measures including duration, convexity and DV01.
projects.preview_label: Kenya Yield Curve · Treasury yield and interest-rate risk workspace

projects.name: FINTEL — Kenya Financial Intelligence
projects.description: A market-intelligence platform for Kenya, bringing CBK observations, FX, Treasury bills and bonds, yield-curve tools and quantitative research into one workspace. The live product is being actively upgraded.
projects.preview_alt: FINTEL product interface preview based on its current React homepage and design system

projects.name: Kenya Investment Intelligence
projects.description: A Kenyan financial-market research platform developed from the Kenya Investment Outlook 2026 and the Rock Investment Bank Research Challenge 2026, in collaboration with Edward Chege Waweru. Its live dashboard brings equities, fixed income, macroeconomic indicators, risk analysis and research provenance into one workspace. The first dashboard release is online; approved market-data integration, report validation and automatic deployment from GitHub are still being completed.
projects.preview_alt: The live Kenya Investment Intelligence dashboard showing its research navigation, market snapshot and approved-data-feed status.
projects.preview_label: Kenya Investment Intelligence · live research dashboard

projects.name: Nkaulele Contractors Limited
projects.description: The official company website for Nkaulele Contractors Limited, based in Nkoilale, Maasai Mara. It introduces the company, construction and civil engineering services, project approach, company-provided work imagery and direct project enquiries.
projects.preview_alt: Full-width home page preview for Nkaulele Contractors Limited, showing the company wordmark, navigation, hero, authentic company site photograph and location strip
